note: Every workflow in this repo that can WRITE to production data — built by reading .github/workflows/*.yml for an `execute` input or a literal --execute/--apply/--prune-logs flag, not from anyone's memory of the list. `cadence` is the lane's own clock; `executeInput` is the dispatch input that turns writing on, or "flag" when the flag is hardcoded. `since` is the lane's first green run and is null everywhere today: improvements/audits/workflow-health-latest.json records LAST success, not first, so the counter falls back to the 8-week observation window and says so (spanBasis).
